tei:div.tei:p: (ba)༄༅// chos rin po che nye bar bzhengs pa'i mtshon byed kyi rab tu byed pa zhes bya ba/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i chu gter las 'khrungs shing*// mkhyen brtse'i lo 'dab kun nas rab rgyas la// phrin las dri bsung phyogs bcur rab ldang ba// sangs rgyas rnam par rgyas pa'i pad+mo rgyal// dam chos yongs su smin pa'i sbrang rtsi ltar// srid zhi'i phun tshogs skyes pa'i bcud ldan zhing*// gang gis myang ba'i dpal du nyer 'gyur ba// gsung rab bdud rtsi 'gro la rgyal gyur cig /dam chos bdud rtsis blo gros lus rdzogs shing*// rnam grol rigs pa'i 'dab gshog rab rgyas nas// legs bshad sgra dbyangs kun tu legs sgrogs pa// dge 'dun bung ba'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo// zhi ba zag med dbyings la nyer brten zhing*// dkon mchog dge ba de dag 'byung ba'i gnas// nyes pa bkru ba'i 'jug ngogs mchog gyur pa// dpal ldan bla ma'i pad rdzing gis skyongs shig /gang gi rang bzhin gdod nas rnam dag glo bur spros pa'i spros bral yang*// sprul pa'i spros pa kun tu spro mdzad dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus dang*// spros dang spros med zung du chud gyur rgyal sras rnams dang de bzhin du// spros pas ma spros slob dang mi slob slob ma'i tshogs bskyed yum la 'dud// yum de yi ni sras gyur pa'i// rgyal ba rgya mtsho rnams kyi zhing*// 'jig rten khams ni bgrang yas las// 'di ni mi mjed 'jig rten khams// dus ni bskal pa bzang po la// gnyis kyis lhag pa'i sangs rgyas stong*// 'gro ba'i don du byon pa las// rnam 'dren rnam pa gsum gyi rjes// skye dgu'i tshe lo brgya pa'i tshe// shākya'i rgyal po nye bar byon// bstan pa lo grangs lnga brgya phrag /bcu ru gnas par gsungs pa las// lnga brgya bdun pa'i dus kyi tshe// 'dzam bu'i gling gi byang phyogs char// sngon spyad dpal gyi mthus byung ba// rgyal po gzhan gyi dpal 'phrog cing*// rang dpal rnam par rgyal gyur pa// jing gir gan zhes bya ba byung*// de sras sa bdag gnyis pa ni// ga gan rgyal po zhes bya ba// des kyang phyogs gzhan zil mnan nas// dpal gyi gzi yis lham mer bzhugs// de yi sras gyur go yug gan// de yang mi yi dbang por gyur// de yi yab mched mang go gan// stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur 'drar gyur// de gcung go pe la zhes bya// de ni gtsug lag kun la thugs// rnam par gsal zhing gsal ba smra// drang po'i chos rjes 'brang ba ste// dge zhing bden pa'i mthu yis te// sa rnams kun la dbang bsgyur ba// 'khor los sgyur rgyal nyid bzhin gyur// de ni zhi bas sa skyong zhing*// dkon mchog mchod la mngon par gzhol// chos kyis bdag gzhan dpal 'phel mdzad// de yi sras ni jim gyim ste// mtho ris dpal gyi gzhi brten zhing*// dad dang thugs rje mkhyen rab kyis// de yi thugs ni rnam par 'byor// yab mes brgyud pa las brgyud pa'i// lugs kyis 'jig rten legs skyong zhing*// 'chi med chos kyi bdud rtsi'i sgor// chos bzhin zhugs nas chos tshul la// tshul bzhin spyad pas tshul bzhin du// nyid kyi dpal 'byor rab rgyas nas// gzhan 'byor dag kyang 'byor mdzad pas// grags pa'i nyi 'od nyi ltar gsal// 'di yi mdzad spyod theg pa mchog gi brtul zhugs dam pas legs brgyan pa'i// thub dbang gis kyang bsngags par 'os pa'i sdom la gnas shing de bzhin du// mthar lta ba yi lta ba kun las rnam par grol zhing dbu ma yi// yang dag lta bas lta ba rnam dag sgrub pa bzang pos bsgrubs pa la// nye bar gzhol bas gzhal du med pa'i bsod nams tshogs bskrun dam pa yis// nye bar bsngags pa'i dkar po'i las la gcig tu brtson mdzad khyad par du// sangs rgyas sku gzugs bzhengs nas mchod dang dam chos 'dri dang klog pa dang*// dge 'dun mchod sogs thar pa'i 'jug ngogs mchog la nges par 'di zhugs so// 'di yi yab mes dag gi bka' drin la// kun nas lan du blan par bya phyir dang*// rang gi bla med byang chub thob bya'i phyir// dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus bskyed pa'i yum// rgyal sras rnams kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam// lhar bcas 'gro ba'i bde legs 'byung ba'i gzhi// shes rab pha rol phyin ma zhes bya ba// stong phrag brgya yi tshad du gsungs pa gang*// nye bar bzhengs zhes bka' lung legs stsol nas// de gsung spyi bor dang du len byed pa// ston tshul zhes byas bdag rkyen legs byas te// shing mo phag lo'i ston zla rnam gsum la// baiḍūr+ya 'dra'i zhing sa dag pa'i gzhir// 'dzam bu'i chu gser zhun ma'i rang bzhin gyis// 'phrul gyi yi ge'i bzo la legs sbyangs pa// sum pa dge slong tshul khrims dpal dang ni// bkra shis dpal sogs mkhas pa'i tshogs rnams kyis// legs par bris nas sna tshogs rig pa yi// bzo bo'i tshogs kyis dras dang glegs shing sogs// kun nas dge zhing phun sum tshogs par bsgrubs// rab tu gnas pa'ang gsung rab ji bzhin du// dge 'dun rgya mtsho rgya mtsho lta bus bgyis// de ltar grub pa'i dpal 'bras dam pa 'di// lhar bcas 'gro ba'i mchod pa'i rten du gyur// de yi tshul yang tshul bzhin du// snyan ngag snyan pas legs brjod cing*// lha dang lha min tshogs rnams dang*// mi dang mi'am ci la sogs// 'byung po gang dag 'dir lhags rnams// rna ba blags te mnyan par gyis// glegs shing gser gyi mdog snang ba// 'dzum pa'i mdangs 'od 'byin pa ni// thub pa dges pas nyid sras la// 'dzum pa mdzad pa lta bur gda'// glegs shing phye bas nang gi mdangs// dmar zhing kun nas 'tsher ba ni// rgyal ba'i zhal gyi sgros gsal nas// ljags kyi dbang po bkram 'drar mchis// mthing shog mthing ga'i mdangs chags la// dbang po'i gzhu yi 'od 'byin pa// ljags las bye ba khrag khrig 'od// kun nas 'byin pa lta bur gda'// gser gyi yi ge gser phreng ltar// phreng du dngar zhing bstan pa ni// ljags kyi 'od kyi rtse mo la// thub pa'i sku gzugs bkram 'drar mchis// yi ge'i gug skyed gang 'og tu// lding zhing 'khyug par gnas pa ni// sprul pa'i sku la rgyal sras dang*// slob mas zhabs 'bring bgyis 'drar gda'// yi ge de 'dra klog pa la// shin tu mkhas pas bklags pa'i sgra// yan lag drug cu'i gsung dbyangs kyis// don de nyid ni ston 'drar mchis// klog gi sgra yis der 'dus pa'i// skye bo'i yid ni zhi bgyid pa// chos thos pa yi 'khor rnams kyis// chos don bden pa mthong 'drar gda'// 'di 'dra'i dge bas bdag gzhan kun// dge bar bgyis khyod 'di 'bras kyis// myur du phyogs bcur chos sgrogs pa'i// chos kyi rgyal por 'gyur lags grang*// de ltar dam chos rin chen gyi// nye bar bzhengs nas mchod dang bklags pa yi// dge ba 'di dang dge ba'i rtsa ba gzhan// gcig tu bsdoms nas rgyal sras jim gyim dang*// btsun mo dam pa go go can dang ni// sras kyi thu bor gyur pa ka ma la// gnyis par gyur pa dharma pha la dang*// gsum pa de mur dang ni de bzhin du// sras mo gu log gī ti zhes bya dang*// slad nas 'byon par 'gyur ba'i gdung rgyud bcas// gnas skabs sku tshe chu bo'i rgyun ltar ring*// dpal 'byor rgya mtsho che ltar ngang gis 'phel// lha yi dbang po lta bur dbang dang ldan// tshangs dbang lta bur nad med bder gnas shing*// grub pa'i lha dang rig pa 'dzin pa ltar// bzhed dgu thams cad chos bzhin 'grub gyur cig

/srid pa kun tu lha mi'i dpal 'byor gyis// rnam par 'byor zhing rgyal ba rgya mtsho las// chos tshul rgya mtsho gsan nas legs spyad de// kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i go 'phang brnyes par shog /de ltar bsngags 'os bsngags dang bsngo ba yi// rab byed 'di ni dge slong 'phags pa yis// me pho byi ba dpyid zla ra ba yi// bcu bzhi'i nyin par smar khams sgang du bris// phyogs dang dus thams cad du bkra shis par gyur cig/ // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
